Thousands protest German far-right AfD party conference

Thousands of demonstrators gathered in Erfurt, Germany, to protest the far-right Alternative for Germany (AfD) party's annual congress. Riot police were deployed, and clashes occurred between police and protesters attempting to block delegates. The conference took place on a date significant to the Nazi era, raising concerns about historical echoes.
